description: This file defines the PolicyBuilder interface and its nested LabelScoped interface, providing a fluent API for constructing Policy objects with various configurations of subjects, resources, permissions, and metadata. It includes methods for setting, removing, and building policy entries, with support for scoping to specific labels.

classes.name: PolicyBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building Policy objects with a fluent API, supporting nested LabelScoped builders for label-specific configurations.

classes.name: PolicyBuilder.LabelScoped
classes.description: Sub-interface extending PolicyBuilder, providing methods scoped to a specific Label for setting subjects, resources, permissions, and exiting back to the main builder.

methods.name: forLabel
methods.description: Returns a LabelScoped builder scoped to the given Label.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the Policy ID, deprecated method accepting CharSequence, use setId(PolicyId) instead.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the Policy ID with a typed PolicyId object.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle of the policy.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision of the policy, accepting either a long or a PolicyRevision object.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a PolicyEntry, replacing any existing entry with the same label.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple PolicyEntries, replacing existing entries with the same labels.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a PolicyEntry by label.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a PolicyEntry by PolicyEntry object.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes multiple PolicyEntries.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Sets Subjects for a specific label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Sets a Subject for a specific label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Sets a Subject for a label with issuer, subject, and subjectType.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Sets a Subject for a label with issuer and subject.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a Subject from a label by issuer and subject.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Sets Resources for a label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Sets a Resource for a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a Resource from a label by ResourceKey.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a Resource from a label by Resource.

methods.name: setPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets EffectedPermissions for a resource in a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets granted Permissions for a resource in a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissions
methods.description: Sets granted Permissions for a resource type and path in a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissions
methods.description: Sets granted Permissions for a ResourceKey in a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissions
methods.description: Sets granted Permissions with specific permission strings in a label.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets revoked Permissions for a resource in a label.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissions
methods.description: Sets revoked Permissions for a ResourceKey in a label.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissions
methods.description: Sets revoked Permissions with specific permission strings in a label.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable Policy object based on the configured entries.
